# 🛑 STOP: Do not report security vulnerabilities publicly!

If you believe you have discovered a vulnerability, bypass, or secret leakage edge case:

1. **Submit a Private Security Advisory**:
   👉 **[Click here to report privately on GitHub](https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield/security/advisories/new)**

2. **Or Email the Security Team directly**:
   📧 **[developer@ritualdev.com](mailto:developer@ritualdev.com)**
   *(Subject: `[SECURITY] Potential Vulnerability in AgentShield`)*

We provide a **guaranteed 24-hour response SLA** and full Safe Harbor protection for security researchers.
